run_seq2seq_training: run a seq2seq model training pipeline using HuggingFace transformers with NeuralDB datasets and custom instance generators
run_evaluation: run evaluation on a trained seq2seq model using validation or test data files with baseline or SPJ metrics
get_generator: get the appropriate reader class, generator class, kwargs, and evaluation function for a given instance generator name like perfectir or spj
dict_flatten: flatten a nested dictionary into a single-level dictionary using a configurable separator like dot or underscore
DataTrainingArguments: create a dataclass to configure training data files, max source and target lengths, padding, and beam search settings
